_comment: OpenCV HSV: hue 0-179, sat 0-255, val 0-255. hue_window = ±half-width. sat_max triggers dark-kit bypass (wins before hue competition).

team_a._note: Enniskillen Rangers red. sat_min=120 filters out warm background tones (soil, boards) which have S<120 but H in red range.

team_b._note: Black opposition + goalkeepers. Catchall: assigned to any track that doesn't match team_a or referee by hue window.
